decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and numbered Design and Access Statement, Historic Narrative, 010, 009, 050, 051, 052A, 053A, 054, 055, 056, 109, 212, Received 19 January 2011, SK037 (annotated), 222 (annotated), Received 14 March 2011 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is occupied).

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings to the minimum extent possible.

Condition : 4 - In the case of intervention in original walls, nib and/or downstands shall be retained to show the historical past of the building. Supporting beams shall be retained, and if changed because of rot, shall remain visible as a downstand. The nib shall have a minimum depth of 0.2m.

Condition : 5 - The internal arch shall be finished in a combination of render, steel and brickwork to complement the existing dwelling and proposed extensions, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The original arched brickwork (three bricks within the western wall) found shall be retained and protect. The brickwork shall not be covered over, rendered or similar, unless otherwise agreed with the Local Planning Authority.
description: Alterations to recently excavated basement cellar, including the construction of a new stair access, and studwork to make the basement structurally sound.
